compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug b594-de6d-3ebc-490f fixed reroute_migrated_plans so inbound update, conflict and repair_property plans are no longer dispatched through the outbound handlers. The selection filter was unchanged from 2026-08-25 (d49466b5e96), so bridge runs since then may have written Jira-side changes back to Jira or reposted Jira comments. No production run has been inspected.

## Approach
Read-only: sample bridge-run manifests and Jira issue histories since 2026-08-25 for an update_issue or add_comment on a key whose same-pass plan was inbound, and for comment duplicates. Record issue keys and comment ids on this ticket. Do not write to Jira.

## Testing
Read-only inspection of recorded manifests and Jira history; no code change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A sample of bridge-run manifests since 2026-08-25 is checked for outbound writes against inbound plans (checked: result and the sampled run ids recorded in a ticket comment).
- [ ] Any duplicated Jira comment or written-back field found is listed with issue key and comment id, or the sample is recorded as clean.
compiled_state.title: Check whether past bridge runs wrote inbound Jira changes back to Jira
